name: quantral
description: Read Quantral's conversation signal scores, recaps, stories, author track records, company facts and upcoming events, US patents and lobbying, your watchlist and tracked strategies for public companies.

interface.longDescription:
Quantral tracks what retail investors and market commentators are saying about public companies across Reddit, X, Substack, YouTube shows, Korean investor blogs and regulator filings, and turns that conversation into a signal score per company.

Connected to ChatGPT, Quantral answers questions like "Which stocks have the strongest conversation today?", "What is the Quantral score for NVDA?" or "What has the conversation around SNDK been about?" with live data: a ranked list of the names being talked about, one company's score for the last 24 hours and 7 days, month-by-month recaps of what people said, short stories about the bursts of chatter happening this week, the individual posts and filings behind a score, the authors with the strongest verified track records and any one author's record, a company's facts and returns, its upcoming earnings and other dates, its recent US patent grants and federal lobbying, sectors ranked by their conversation, the stocks on your own Quantral watchlist, and Quantral's tracked strategies (rule-based lists of 10 stocks, rebuilt weekly and compared with the S&P 500). Rankings, scores, recaps, stories and strategies render as cards inside the chat.

The Quantral score (0 to 100) measures the strength and credibility of market conversation across the sources Quantral tracks, weighted by source and author track record. Each score carries a tier: Exceptional, Strong, Moderate, Weak or Negative. It describes how loud and how credible the conversation is right now. It is not a price prediction, a price target or a recommendation to buy, sell or hold anything. Author hit rates are past graded calls, not forecasts. Strategies are tracked lists with their record, not trades to make. Patents and lobbying are context from public records and do not feed the score. Nothing Quantral returns is investment advice.

Access is read-only. ChatGPT can read signals, scores, recaps, stories, authors, company data, strategies and your watchlist for the Quantral account you sign in with; it cannot change your account, watchlist or settings, and it cannot place trades.

Support: hello@quantral.com.
capabilities: Rank the companies with the strongest market conversation over the last 24 hours or 7 days
Look up a company by name or ticker to see whether Quantral covers it
Read one company's conversation signal score for the 24 hour and 7 day windows, with tier words
Read a company's facts, returns and upcoming earnings, dividends and other events
Read a company's recent US patent grants and its federal lobbying spend and reports
Read month-by-month recaps of what was said about a company
Read this week's stories about bursts of chatter around a company, and the posts behind each one
Read the individual posts and filings behind a company's score, with author track records
Look up one author's track record by handle or name
Rank sectors and industries by the strength of their conversation
Read the scores of the stocks on your own Quantral watchlist
List the authors with the strongest verified track record of graded calls
Read Quantral's tracked strategies, their current lists, records and weekly changes
defaultPrompt: What stocks have the strongest conversation today?
What's the Quantral score for NVDA?
What has the conversation around SNDK been about over the last few months?

positive.prompt: What stocks have the strongest conversation today on Quantral?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_top_signals with the 24h window and shows the ranked card of companies with their scores and tier words (Exceptional, Strong, Moderate, Weak, Negative). The answer frames the scores as conversation strength, not as a prediction or a recommendation.

positive.prompt: What's the Quantral score for NVDA?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company_score for NVDA and shows the score card with the 24h and 7d scores and tiers. A null score is described as no tracked mentions in that window. No buy or sell language. When the response includes chips (for example Turned positive, Split views, insider buying or high volatility), the answer mentions them.

positive.prompt: What has the conversation around SNDK been about over the last few months?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company_recaps for SNDK (optionally search_companies first to confirm the ticker) and shows the recaps card with the latest months and what the conversation was about.

positive.description: This week's stories and the posts behind one
positive.prompt: What are people talking about this week on Quantral? Show me the posts behind the top story.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_stories without a week and shows the stories card with this week's headlines, summaries, kinds (New, Divided, Rising, Trending) and companies, then calls get_story for the first story and lists the posts behind it with their sources and author track records. Stories are presented as summaries of chatter, not news reports or advice.

positive.description: Authors with the strongest track record
positive.prompt: Who has the best track record on Quantral?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_top_authors and lists authors with their sources and hit rates, presented as past graded calls, never as a forecast of future accuracy.

positive.description: Tracked strategies and their current lists
positive.prompt: What strategies does Quantral track, and what's in the top one right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_strategies, then get_strategy for one strategy, and shows its current list of 10 stocks with the live record and the backtest labeled separately, compared with SPY. The strategy is presented as a tracked list, not as trades the user should make.

positive.prompt: When does NVDA report earnings next, and what are its market cap and returns this year on Quantral?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_upcoming_events for NVDA and get_company_profile for NVDA, and reports the next earnings date with its timing and the market cap and year-to-date return as facts, without a recommendation.

positive.description: Patents and lobbying for a company
positive.prompt: What US patents has Microsoft been granted lately, and how much does it spend on lobbying?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_company_patents and get_company_lobbying for MSFT, lists recent grants with dates and the latest quarter's lobbying spend with its change on a year earlier and recent reports, and says both are context that does not feed the score.

positive.prompt: How is my Quantral watchlist doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_watchlist and lists the companies on the signed-in account's watchlist with their 24h and 7d scores and tier words, describing a null score as no tracked mentions, not a low score.

positive.description: One author's record and sector rankings
positive.prompt: Look up the track record of the author with the best record on Quantral, then tell me which sectors have the strongest conversation.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_top_authors, then get_author for the top one, and get_industry_scores for sectors; presents hit rates as past graded predictions and sector scores with tier words, not as forecasts.

negative.description: Billing changes. Quantral's connection is read-only and has no billing or account tools; the assistant should say it cannot cancel or change the subscription from ChatGPT and call no tool to do so.
Trade execution. Quantral is read-only and has no trading capability; the assistant should say it cannot place trades and call no tool to do so.
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of TSLA for me.

negative.description: Account changes. The connection is read-only; the assistant should explain it cannot change the user's Quantral watchlist or account.
negative.prompt: Add TSLA to my Quantral watchlist.

review.commerce_description: Quantral does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Quantral account.

publication.release_notes: Adds seven read-only tools: get_company_profile (facts and returns), get_upcoming_events (earnings and other dates), get_company_patents (US patent grants), get_company_lobbying (federal lobbying spend and reports), get_watchlist (the signed-in account's watchlist with scores), get_author (one author's track record) and get_industry_scores (sectors and industries ranked by conversation). get_company_score now includes the chips the company page shows when they apply. Eighteen read-only tools in total; no changes to sign-in.
